tools.name: cusip_validate
tools.description: CUSIP check digit. Nine characters from digits, letters, and * @ #. Spaces are ignored and hyphens are not. From the left, values are weighted 1, 2, 1, 2 and the digits of those products sum to the check digit. A CUSIP made only of letters and digits is also returned as a US ISIN. This does not look the issuer up.

tools.name: fund_holdings
tools.description: Mutual fund / ETF portfolio from its latest public SEC Form N-PORT: top holdings by value (name, CUSIP, ISIN, LEI, shares, USD value, % of net assets, asset and issuer category, country, maturity/coupon for debt), asset-class / country / issuer / currency mix, top-10 concentration, net assets and monthly returns per share class. Look up by fund ticker (VOO, QQQ, BND), series id or class id.

fund.description: Mutual fund or ETF ticker, SEC series id (S000002839) or class id (C000092055). Aliases: ticker, series

limit.description: Top holdings to return by absolute USD value (1-100, default 25)

tools.name: sec_13f
tools.description: Institutional holdings from a fund manager's latest SEC 13F-HR: the information table parsed from EDGAR, aggregated by CUSIP (issuer, class, shares, USD value, portfolio weight, put/call, voting authority), with filing period, totals, amendment and recent-filing links. Look up by manager name or CIK, or pin a specific accession.

fund.description: Investment manager name or CIK (e.g. Berkshire Hathaway, 1067983). Aliases: cik, manager

limit.description: Top holdings to return by value (1-500, default 25)

accession.description: Specific 13F-HR accession number (e.g. 0001193125-26-352200); default = latest original 13F-HR
